caption: The drawing depicts a single chest or box centered prominently on the page. The chest is rectangular with a rounded lid and is shown in a front-facing view. The main body of the chest is brown with a woodgrain texture, and the top lid has a darker, more solid brown color. Decorative elements include a border of small circular studs in a reddish or copper shade along the outline of the lid, several larger round metal or studded accents in a triangular pattern on the front, and a black, ornate central lock with a metal plate. The background of the drawing is light beige or off-white and features faint, unfinished pencil sketches or technical diagrams of the same or similar chest in different views, such as plan and side views, as well as an oval marking with the initials "S.K." in the upper right quadrant. There are also some light linear markings and a small scale indicator in pencil below the chest drawing. No other objects are present.
